prompt: Create an AutoResizeTextarea component that uses ngAfterViewInit to measure its initial rendered height via viewChild() and ngOnDestroy (or DestroyRef) to clean up a ResizeObserver. The component should implement the OnInit, AfterViewInit, and OnDestroy interfaces. Use the modern signal-based viewChild() to get a reference to the textarea element.

assertions.text: Uses viewChild() function (not @ViewChild decorator) to reference the textarea
Implements OnInit, AfterViewInit, and OnDestroy interfaces
Uses ngAfterViewInit to read initial element dimensions
Cleans up ResizeObserver in ngOnDestroy or via DestroyRef.onDestroy()
viewChild uses a template reference variable string or ElementRef read option
